ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task-type matching. The query is a clearly-specified coding task (generate a shuffled list of numbers) with a deterministic correct output, which falls squarely in Willet's top-preferred "well-specified extraction/transform" family (win-rate 66 vs. ~50 baseline). Since capability evals are effectively tied between the two models (all differences under ~2 points and noting preference doesn't affect output quality), I used self-reported task preference as the tiebreaker, and Willet most strongly prefers this kind of precise, well-defined work.
